definitions.text_mt: Jifhem xi ħaġa: japprendi t-tifsira, l-iskop jew in-natura ta' xi ħaġa permezz tal-ħsieb.

usage_examples.en: I understood what he told me.

usage_examples.mt: Ma nifhem xejn minn din il-problema.
usage_examples.en: I do not understand anything about this problem.
Do you understand Italian?

definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' 'fehem': il-proċess jew il-ħila li wieħed jifhem.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fehim tiegħu tal-lingwa huwa tajjeb ħafna.
usage_examples.en: His understanding of the language is very good.
There is a lack of understanding between them.

definitions.text_mt: Ġudizzju jew ħsieb personali dwar xi ħaġa.
Għarfien jew interpretazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: X'inhi l-fehma tiegħek dwar dan is-suġġett?
usage_examples.en: What is your opinion on this subject?
Our opinions are different.

definitions.text_mt: Vantaġġ jew utilità li wieħed jikseb minn xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.en: What is the usefulness of this device?
There is no benefit in going there.

definitions.text_mt: Ifejjaq lil min hu marid: iġib is-saħħa u l-benesseri lil persuna jew organu.
definitions.text_en: to heal, to make sound, to give back health to

usage_examples.en: The doctor healed the patient.
This medicine heals many illnesses.

definitions.text_mt: Li jġib benefiċċju jew qligħ.

usage_examples.en: This business is very lucrative.
Look for advantageous opportunities.

definitions.text_mt: F'liema post, lok jew sitwazzjoni.

usage_examples.en: Where did you go yesterday?
I do not know where he is.

definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' 'fieq': l-irkupru minn marda jew tbatija.

usage_examples.en: I am hoping for his recovery.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fejqan minn din il-marda jieħu żmien twil.
usage_examples.en: Recovery from this illness takes a long time.

definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' 'fieq': l-irkupru minn marda jew tbatija.

usage_examples.en: His recovery was wonderful.
I wish you a speedy recovery.

definitions.text_mt: Nom verbali ta' 'fiet': nuqqas ta' suċċess jew telfa.

usage_examples.en: After many attempts, it was all a failure.

etymology_chain.definition: rue, a plant from the genus Ruta

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta aromatika perenni tal-ġeneru Ruta, b'weraq griż-ħadrani u fjuri sofor.

usage_examples.en: Rue has a strong smell.
In our garden there is a rue plant.

definitions.text_mt: Pjanta aromatika perenni tal-ġeneru Ruta, b'weraq griż-ħadrani u fjuri sofor.

usage_examples.en: Rue grows on riverbanks.

definitions.text_mt: Jekkren: jimxi bil-mod ħafna u b'kawtela.

usage_examples.en: The old man walked very slowly towards the door.
Do not walk so slowly, hurry up a bit!

definitions.text_mt: Rettili tal-familja Testudinidae b'qoxra iebsa u riġlejn qosra, li jiċċaqlaq bil-mod.

usage_examples.en: I saw a large turtle in the sea.
The tortoise carries its house on its back.

etymology_chain.definition: to louse, inspect someone’s head for lice

definitions.text_mt: Jifela xi ħaġa: jeżamina b'attenzjoni kbira, iħares lejn kull dettall.

usage_examples.en: I inspected it carefully before buying it.
The jeweller scrutinised the diamond.

definitions.text_en: to be able to afford, endure, or withstand
definitions.text_mt: Jiflaħ xi ħaġa: ikollu l-kapaċità finanzjarja jew fiżika biex jagħmel jew jissaporti xi ħaġa.

definitions.text_en: to be fine, healthy, or successful
definitions.text_mt: Jiflaħ: ikun f'saħħtu, b'saħħtu jew b'suċċess.

usage_examples.en: He cannot afford to buy a new house.
How are you? I am fine, thank you.

definitions.text_mt: Biċċa injama jew metall irqiqa li tintuża biex tifred jew iżżomm żewġ uċuħ.

definitions.text_en: a splinter or any small piece
definitions.text_mt: Ċiqalfa jew framment żgħir minn xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Daħħal feles biex iżżomm il-bieb miftuħ.
usage_examples.en: Insert a wedge to keep the door open.

definitions.text_mt: Jfellel xi ħaġa: jaqtagħha fi flieli rqaq.
Jfellel: jagħmel qatgħa fonda f'xi ħaġa.
Jfellel l-art: ikisser jew iħaffer il-ħamrija.

usage_examples.en: I sliced the bread for the sandwich.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bidwi fellel l-art qabel ma żera'.
usage_examples.en: The farmer broke up the soil before sowing.

definitions.text_mt: Jfelles: iħalli l-bajd jitfaqqas u joħorġu l-flieles.
Jfelles: jibda jikber u jagħti l-weraq jew il-friegħi.
Jfelles: idaħħal feles f'xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.en: The hen hatched all the chicks.
The tree began to bud in spring.

definitions.text_mt: Sezzjoni jew porzjon maqtugħ minn xi ħaġa.
Xaqq jew qasma fil-ġilda tal-għarqub.
Il-warrani jew il-ġewż.

usage_examples.en: Give me another slice of cheese.
He sat on his buttocks.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew għodda li taqta' xi ħaġa fi flieli.

usage_examples.mt: Uża dan il-felliel biex taqta' t-tadam.
usage_examples.en: Use this slicer to cut the tomatoes.

definitions.text_mt: Li jista' jaqta' jew li għandu l-ħila jaqta' fi flieli.

usage_examples.en: This knife is good for slicing.

definitions.text_mt: Qawwi, b'saħħtu u robust.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa raġel fellieħ u jista' jerfa' piżijiet tqal.
usage_examples.en: He is a strong man and can lift heavy weights.

etymology_chain.definition: any young animal, young, especially: a chick, chicken or any young fowl a foal

definitions.text_mt: Ferd żgħir tat-tiġieġ li għadu kif faqqas.
Suspett jew dubju dwar xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.en: The hen has five chicks.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi fellus li mhux se jkun hemm problema.
usage_examples.en: I have a suspicion that there will not be a problem.

definitions.text_mt: Katina tal-ħadid li tintuża biex torbot saqajn il-ħabs.

usage_examples.en: They put the shackles on his feet.
The prisoner was bound with fetters.
